title: Everyone Else Bounces
premise: An elephant bounces on a backyard trampoline. The trampoline does not move. The elephant does not leave it. Everyone else on the street goes up instead, and comes down in their own yard.
visual: 4:3, locked 3/4 view over the back fences from the alley. A row of five identical cream houses with brown pyramid roofs, one pale blue window glowing. Two-tone green checker lawns, white picket posts between the yards, a grey alley floor, flat light-blue sky. Centre yard: a grey sphere elephant with two dot eyes, flap ears, hose trunk and four hose legs planted on a round black trampoline with a green padded rim. Left to right: a mailman (navy cap, tan bag), a long reddish-brown dachshund, a man in a white clawfoot tub with a yellow duck, a grandma in a green lawn chair with a pale yellow glass. Three wheelie bins in three different blues and one orange cone at the alley edge, a grey lamp post with a cold white head. Everyone's face is two dot eyes and never changes.

Camera locked.
